name: Jelajah stamp
description: Pay a stall in a Jelajah stamp rally and receive its stamp NFT in the same transaction; burn a full set at the rally vault for the reward and a trophy.

resources.name: Jelajah
resources.description: Stamp rallies on Bitcoin Cash (BCH BLAZE 2026).

buyer.name: Buyer
buyer.description: Pays the stall and receives its stamp; later burns a full set for the reward.

buyStamp.name: Buy and stamp
buyStamp.description: Pay a stall $(<stallPrice>) satoshis and receive its stamp NFT.

claimSet.name: Claim the reward
claimSet.description: Burn $(<needed>) stamps from different stalls for $(<reward>) satoshis and a trophy.

buyStampTransaction.name: Stamped at a stall
buyStampTransaction.description: Paid $(<stallPrice>) satoshis and received a Jelajah stamp.

claimSetTransaction.name: Rally set claimed
claimSetTransaction.description: Burned $(<needed>) stamps for $(<reward>) satoshis and a trophy.

vaultInput.name: Rally vault
vaultInput.description: The rally's reward pool, holding the vault's minting NFT.

minterInput.name: Stall minter
minterInput.description: The stall's covenant coin, holding the rally's minting NFT.

vaultOutput.name: Rally vault
vaultOutput.description: The vault keeps its minting NFT and pays out exactly one reward.

rewardOutput.name: Your reward
rewardOutput.description: $(<reward>) satoshis to the buyer of the stamps.

trophyOutput.name: Your trophy
trophyOutput.description: Trophy NFT: 00 followed by your public key hash.

minterOutput.name: Stall minter
minterOutput.description: The minter goes back to the covenant unchanged.

stampOutput.name: Your stamp
stampOutput.description: The stall stamp NFT, bound to your key: stall id followed by your public key hash.

rewardVault.name: Jelajah reward vault
rewardVault.description: Pays one reward per set of stamps from different stalls, all bought by the claimer.

stampMinter.name: Jelajah stall minter
stampMinter.description: Lets a stamp out only when the stall is paid at least its price, in the same transaction.
